description.zh: 让助手的回复结构保持稳定。在系统提示词组装时追加一段输出规范：结论先行、不写开场套话、篇幅贴合复杂度、缺信息用占位符继续、工具失败换实现、长任务给阶段性结论、区分已确认与未验证。支持三档风格切换、工具清单收敛、调用审计与配置快照回滚。只改输出格式，不改角色设定与语气。
description.en: Keeps the assistant's response structure consistent. Appends a response-convention section while the system prompt is assembled: lead with the result, no preamble, length matched to complexity, placeholders instead of stalling, switch implementation on tool failure, checkpoint conclusions for long tasks, and confirmed-versus-unverified labelling. Includes three style modes, tool-list pruning, a call audit, and configuration snapshots with rollback. Output format only; character and tone stay untouched.

description.zh: style_status / style_configure / style_audit / style_revert：让模型自己查看与调整输出风格、读取工具调用审计。
description.en: style_status / style_configure / style_audit / style_revert: lets the model inspect and adjust the style profile and read the tool audit.
